title: chamaeiris graminea
intro: Chamaeiris graminea, commonly known as Wild Chamomile or Pineapple Weed, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is a member of the daisy family and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include relieving stress and anxiety, promoting sleep, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chamaeiris graminea are attributed to its calming and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as insomnia, restlessness, and digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Chamaeiris graminea include apigenin, chamazulene, and borneol, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
